title: Vendor the design-os taste into packages/bee/design with its license
action:
Vendor the design-os taste from /mnt/data/Projects/goglbe/design-os at commit a7ad5f1 (package ease-design 0.6.1) into bee as six ready-made skill directories under packages/bee/design/ (per D1). NOTHING goes under skills/: regen renders every skills/bee-* dir into both plugin trees (devtools/skill_trees.rs:447), which would ship every pack to every plugin host with no pick and break D4. packages/bee/ ships with the plugin and onboard reads it (onboard/source.rs:57); slice 2 makes onboard copy the picked ones into hosts.

(1) CORE packages/bee/design/bee-design/. Write SKILL.md as a bee skill (frontmatter name bee-design, a one-line description: shaping, building, critiquing or auditing rendered UI). Adapt the design-os-designer workflow (Concept, Build, Check, Hand over, Adjust) and its need-to-file routing table, pointing at files inside references/. Keep the taste text as upstream wrote it; change only paths and tool names. The Check step runs `npx --yes ease-design@0.6.1 gate <page.html> --dir . --json` for now; slice 3 replaces it with `bee design gate`. Say plainly that without Node 20 or newer the check does not run and the worker must say so. The SKILL.md names each pack and the project type it serves. Copy into references/: accessibility, color-science, token-taxonomy, taste-rubric, design-tells, content-design, page-structures, build-loop, ux-psychology, ds-guidelines, design-review, verification-honesty, mode-constraints, need-routing, component-catalog, generation-craft-defaults, design-soul, design-reuse-ladder, qualified-delivery, user-evidence, visual-regression, domain-packs/, plus the designer skill's concepts.md, rules.md and contract.md. The designer's Node scripts (build.mjs, validate.mjs, look.mjs and their helpers) are NOT copied: bee's check is the gate, and the three-width look sheet is deferred; say so in UPSTREAM.json and file it with `bee backlog add`.

(2) PACKS, one directory each under packages/bee/design/, each with a SKILL.md that names its project type and routes to its references/: bee-design-web (web-technique-craft, web-techniques/, patterns/, pattern-cards, signature-devices, designmd-format, ds-kit-onboarding), bee-design-charts (chart-craft, chart-grammars/, diagram-craft, diagram-grammars/, diagram-icons, flow-craft), bee-design-motion (motion-craft, gsap-motion-direction, scroll-cinema-direction, shader-gradient-direction, shader-gradient/, canvas-effect-direction, canvas-ui/, asset-production-orchestration, gflow-hand, delivery-assets), bee-design-apple (apple-swiftui-craft, native-ios-craft, native-ios/, native-ipados-craft, native-ipados/, native-macos-craft, native-macos/), bee-design-figma (figma-craft/, figma-agent-hand, figma-ds-onboarding).

(3) EXCLUDED, never copied, each listed in UPSTREAM.json `excluded` with this reason: upstream's own agent tooling and governance, not taste — README.md, index.json, capability-profiles.json, authoring-standard, librarian-loop, recall-mind, world-class-learning-loop, versioning-semver, design-agents, prompt-modes, prompt-plan-orchestration, persona-index, personas/; research inputs, not taste — sources/, benchmarks/. If upstream holds a knowledge file this cell names nowhere, stop and report it as [BLOCKED] rather than placing it yourself.

(4) LICENSE (per D2). In packages/bee/design/ add LICENSE.md (the full upstream LICENSE text, its Required Notice line first, verbatim), THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (verbatim upstream), and UPSTREAM.json {repo: https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os, commit: a7ad5f1, version: 0.6.1, excluded: [...]}. Every SKILL.md, core and pack, ends with one line pointing to the license file, by a path that still resolves once onboard copies the skill into a host (name the file and the upstream repo; do not rely on ../ reaching packages/bee/design).

(5) PATHS. Upstream holds about 12 `../../knowledge/x.md` links and about 89 backtick `knowledge/...` references. Rewrite every one to the file's new home: within the same skill as references/x.md, across skills by skill name plus file. After rewriting, `rg -n 'knowledge/' packages/bee/design --glob '!UPSTREAM.json' --glob '!LICENSE.md' --glob '!THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md'` prints nothing.

(6) SYNC SCRIPT scripts/sync-design-os.sh <design-os-path>: re-copies exactly the files mapped above into the same destinations, applies the same path rewrite, and rewrites UPSTREAM.json from that checkout's git HEAD and package.json version. The mapping lives in this script only; SKILL.md bodies are bee-authored and never overwritten. No comments in the script (repo rule).

(7) Rewrite the release manifest with `bee dev release-manifest --write` (packages/bee is an inventory root). Do not run `bee dev regen`'s skill-tree step for this cell's sake; if you run regen, confirm afterwards that `fd -t d bee-design .claude-plugin .codex-plugin skills .claude/skills .agents/skills .opencode/skills` prints nothing.
